port 2222
listenaddress 127.0.0.1:2222
hostkey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key
hostkey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_dsa_key
ciphers aes128-ctr,aes128-cbc,3des-cbc
macs hmac-sha2-256,hmac-sha1,hmac-md5
kexalgorithms diffie-hellman-group14-sha1,diffie-hellman-group1-sha1,curve25519-sha256
hostkeyalgorithms ssh-rsa,rsa-sha2-256,ssh-dss
pubkeyacceptedalgorithms ssh-rsa,ssh-ed25519
casignaturealgorithms ssh-ed25519,ssh-dss
